assessment: The study provides evidence that PEN1 and SYP122 regulate structures important for defense against filamentous pathogen infection. The formation of papillae and encasement of haustoria both appear to be ancient defense mechanisms in land plants. The findings that PEN1 and its close homolog SYP122 play an overlapping role in pre- and post-invasive immunity against cell-wall penetrating filamentous pathogens advance our understanding of defense mechanisms against filamentous pathogens.
